C059.name: Lindi Municipal Council
C059.documented: coastal floods, large waves and strong winds, heavy Msimu rain, cholera, and boat accidents

area.en: Lindi Municipal: Lindi Bay shore and Lukuledi estuary
area.sw: Manispaa ya Lindi: ufukwe wa ghuba ya Lindi na mlango wa Lukuledi

risk.en: This area is a low coastal town on Lindi Bay where storm tides and coastal erosion threaten the shoreline, and heavy rain floods low streets near the estuary.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa pwani wa chini kwenye ghuba ya Lindi ambapo mawimbi makubwa na mmomonyoko wa fukwe huhatarisha ufukwe, na mvua kubwa hufurika mitaa ya chini karibu na mlango wa mto.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build back from the shoreline, protect mangroves and keep drains to the sea clear. What raises the risk: building on the beach front or the estuary flats, cutting mangroves for poles or plots, and mining sand from the shore. Know the higher ground inland that you will move to, and go when a storm-tide or strong-wind warning is given or when the low streets near the estuary start to fill; do not wait for the sea to reach the house. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na ufukwe, kulinda mikoko na kuweka mitaro inayoelekea baharini wazi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ufukweni au kwenye tambarare za mlango wa mto, kukata mikoko kwa ajili ya nguzo au viwanja, na kuchimba mchanga ufukweni. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani utakalohamia, na ondoka tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba au upepo mkali inapotolewa au mitaa ya chini karibu na mlango wa mto inapoanza kujaa; usisubiri bahari ifike nyumbani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C057.name: Kilwa District Council
C057.documented: large waves, strong winds, rare tsunami on the open coast, boat accidents, heavy rain, and cholera

area.en: Kilwa: coast, islands and the Matandu river
area.sw: Kilwa: pwani, visiwa na mto Matandu

risk.en: This area includes a long coastline and islands exposed to storm surge, strong winds and erosion, and the Matandu valley where rivers flood fields and roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha pwani ndefu na visiwa vinavyoathiriwa na mawimbi makubwa, upepo mkali na mmomonyoko, na bonde la Matandu ambapo mito hufurika mashamba na barabara.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to keep boats ashore when strong winds are forecast, protect mangroves and keep homes off river flood plains. What raises the risk: putting to sea when strong winds are forecast, building on the beach or the island shore, cutting mangroves, and settling on the Matandu flood plain. Know the higher ground inland or on the island that your village will move to when a storm-surge warning is given, and the raised ground away from the Matandu when the river rises; move early, because island help can take long to arrive. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuweka vyombo ufukweni upepo mkali unapotabiriwa, kulinda mikoko na kujenga nje ya tambarare za mafuriko za mito. Kinachoongeza hatari: kwenda baharini upepo mkali unapotabiriwa, kujenga ufukweni au kando ya kisiwa, kukata mikoko, na kukaa kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Matandu. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani au kisiwani ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba inapotolewa, na eneo lililoinuka mbali na Matandu mto unapojaa; ondokeni mapema, kwani msaada visiwani huchukua muda kufika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C058.name: Lindi District Council
C058.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Lindi DC: Lukuledi valley and coastal villages
area.sw: Lindi DC: bonde la Lukuledi na vijiji vya pwani

risk.en: This area has coastal fishing villages and the Lukuledi river valley, where heavy rain floods farms and cuts rural roads, and dry spells damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya wavuvi vya pwani na bonde la mto Lukuledi, ambapo mvua kubwa hufurika mashamba na kukata barabara za vijijini, na vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to build on higher ground, keep stores above flood level and plant drought-tolerant crops such as cassava and sorghum. What raises the loss in both wet and dry years: building in the Lukuledi valley bottom, trying to cross flooded roads on foot or by motorcycle, and relying on one crop. Know the higher ground and the dry route to it that your village will use when the Lukuledi rises, move stores and animals there before the roads close, and agree early where food will come from in a failed season. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga sehemu za miinuko, kuhifadhi mali juu ya kiwango cha mafuriko na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame kama mihogo na mtama. Kinachoongeza hasara katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na ya ukame: kujenga chini kabisa ya bonde la Lukuledi, kujaribu kuvuka barabara zilizofurika kwa miguu au pikipiki, na kutegemea zao moja. Fahamu eneo la juu na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia Lukuledi inapojaa, hamisheni akiba na mifugo huko kabla barabara hazijafungwa, na kubalianeni mapema chakula kitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

area.en: Mtama: Rondo plateau and Lukuledi slopes
area.sw: Mtama: uwanda wa Rondo na miteremko ya Lukuledi

risk.en: This area has the Rondo plateau and its slopes, where run-off erodes farmland and gullies, and water is scarce on the plateau in the dry season.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina uwanda wa Rondo na miteremko yake, ambapo maji ya mvua humomonyoa mashamba na makorongo, na maji ni haba uwandani wakati wa kiangazi.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep trees and contour bunds on slopes, harvest rainwater and protect water sources. What raises the risk: clearing trees and bunds from the plateau slopes, farming right to the gully edges, and drawing water from unprotected sources in the dry season. Know the firm ground away from the gullies that your household will move to in a heavy storm, and agree early where water will come from when the plateau sources dry up. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha miti na matuta ya kontua kwenye miteremko, kuvuna maji ya mvua na kulinda vyanzo vya maji. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukata miti na matuta kwenye miteremko ya uwanda, kulima hadi kingo za makorongo, na kuchota maji kwenye vyanzo visivyolindwa wakati wa kiangazi. Fahamu eneo imara mbali na makorongo ambalo kaya yako itahamia wakati wa dhoruba kali, na kubalianeni mapema maji yatatoka wapi vyanzo vya uwandani vikikauka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C061.name: Liwale District Council
C061.documented: dry-season drought and wildfire in the Selous woodland, wet-season floods, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Liwale: remote miombo and Selous edge
area.sw: Liwale: miombo ya mbali na pembezoni mwa Selous

risk.en: This area is remote miombo country bordering the Nyerere (Selous) reserve, where wildlife raids crops, dry-season fires spread and rains cut roads for weeks.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nchi ya miombo ya mbali inayopakana na hifadhi ya Nyerere (Selous), ambapo wanyamapori huvamia mazao, moto wa kiangazi husambaa na mvua hukata barabara kwa wiki kadhaa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to use community deterrents against wildlife, keep fire breaks and keep food, water and medicine reserves before the rains. What raises the risk: opening fields right against the reserve boundary, burning late in the dry season on windy days, and letting the household stores run down before the roads close. Know the cleared open ground your village will move to if fire comes, and stock food, water and medicine before the rains cut the roads; if someone falls seriously ill, move them out before the rivers rise, not after. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto na kuweka akiba ya chakula, maji na dawa kabla ya mvua. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba moja kwa moja mpakani mwa hifadhi, kuchoma mwishoni mwa kiangazi siku za upepo, na kuacha akiba za kaya ziishe kabla barabara hazijafungwa. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kijiji chenu kitahamia moto ukija, na wekeni akiba ya chakula, maji na dawa kabla mvua haijakata barabara; mtu akiugua sana, mtoeni kabla mito haijajaa, si baadaye. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C060.name: Nachingwea District Council
C060.documented: drought in the dry months, wet-season floods, wildfire, and strong winds

risk.en: This area is farmland plains producing cashew, sesame and food crops, where erratic rains and dry spells cause crop losses and heavy storms flood low fields.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni tambarare za mashamba yanayozalisha korosho, ufuta na mazao ya chakula, ambapo mvua zisizo za uhakika na vipindi vya ukavu husababisha hasara ya mazao na dhoruba kubwa hufurika mashamba ya chini.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to plant early-maturing and drought-tolerant varieties, keep household food reserves and keep field drains open. What raises the loss in both wet and dry years: relying on one crop, selling the whole harvest at once, and building homes and stores in the low fields that flood. Know the higher ground your household will move to when a heavy storm floods the low fields, and agree early, as a household and a village, where food will come from in a failed season; act before the stores are empty. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mbegu zinazokomaa mapema na kustahimili ukame, kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya na kuweka mifereji ya mashamba wazi. Kinachoongeza hasara katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na ya ukame: kutegemea zao moja, kuuza mavuno yote kwa mara moja, na kujenga nyumba na maghala kwenye mashamba ya chini yanayofurika. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia dhoruba kali inapofurika mashamba ya chini, na kubalianeni mapema, kama kaya na kijiji, chakula kitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana; chukueni hatua kabla akiba haijaisha. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C062.name: Ruangwa District Council
C062.documented: drought, wet-season floods, wildfire, and strong winds

risk.en: This area combines farmland with small-scale gemstone and graphite mining, where pits collapse and flood in the rains and dry spells damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linachanganya mashamba na uchimbaji mdogo wa vito na kinywe, ambapo mashimo hubomoka na kujaa maji wakati wa mvua na vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those living, farming and mining here, it helps to fence or backfill pits, divert run-off away from pit mouths and plant drought-tolerant crops. What raises the risk: digging pits without timbering, working them while rain is falling, building homes at the lip of old pits and relying on one crop. Keep everyone out of the pits once rain starts and know the firm ground away from them that your household will move to; in a dry year, agree early where food and water will come from. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo, kuelekeza maji mbali na midomo ya mashimo na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mashimo bila mihimili, kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha, kujenga nyumba kando ya mashimo ya zamani na kutegemea zao moja. Mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza na fahamu eneo imara mbali nayo ambalo kaya yako itahamia; mwaka wa ukame, kubalianeni mapema chakula na maji vitatoka wapi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
